You incline a finger, sending your spell around the nearer edge of a pillar before it turns toward your mark.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One of your spell attacks; choose one visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you before rolling.
Duration
For that spell.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Choose one of your spell attacks. It can originate from any visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you. Determine cover and attack path from that square, but measure range from you. You must know the target’s location. Roll the spell attack normally.
